title: Music Lab
subtitle: Choose an animal. Hear their world.
hint: Click a name on the ring
audioSoonLabel: Audio coming soon — drop an MP3 into /public/audio

characters.name: Red Fox
characters.description: A curious observer who wanders at the edge of human cities, turning everyday noise into quiet, wandering melodies.

characters.name: Blue Bird
characters.description: Light, high notes for small moments—morning light, short flights, and messages carried across the sky.

characters.name: Green Sea Turtle
characters.description: Slow currents and deep patience. Music that moves like tides—steady, wide, and quietly enduring.

characters.name: Capybara
characters.description: Warm, unhurried beats. The sound of calm company—sitting together while the world rushes past.

characters.name: Beaglier
characters.description: Loyal rhythms and open chords—songs for friendship, doors left cracked, and walks into the unknown.

characters.name: Bunny
characters.description: Soft bounce and pastel haze. Melodies that feel like memories half-remembered in the afternoon.

characters.name: Raccoon
characters.description: Night markets and clever hands. Syncopated footsteps between dumpsters, rooftops, and human leftovers.

characters.name: White Giraffe
characters.description: The prophet’s tone—long lines of harmony that look farther than the horizon and speak without hurry.

characters.name: Korat Cat
characters.description: Precise, silver-edged themes. Intelligence that watches first, then arranges the world into clean motifs.

characters.name: Barbary Lion
characters.description: Last descendant’s anthem—drum and brass for journeys that begin when the old world calls the new.

characters.name: Squirrel
characters.description: Quick motifs and stored seeds of melody—scurrying between trees of knowledge and winter plans.

characters.name: Black Panther
characters.description: Shadow pulse and low voltage. Power that moves silently until everything suddenly feels watched.
